name: two-tip
title: Two tip
description: BIOBUZZ 2-tip auto, pollen only: 16 pollen in 4 volleys of 4. Preload into the south cell; sweep the RED garden and score again for tip 1 (8 pollen, team rule); take flower0's 4 and score them in the north cell, which is up after the tip; take flower1's 4 and score again for tip 2; park. Written for RED and mirrored for BLUE (point symmetry).

steps.notes: Straight north, nose-first, to the spot south of the hive, facing its up (south) cell.

steps.name: spinUp
steps.notes: Spins the pollen shooter up while driving.
Drive out and spin up at the same time.

steps.name: score
steps.notes: Volley 1: the 4 preloaded pollen into the south cell (4 of the 8 that tip it, team rule).

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; 1 in along the next leg's start: a turn on the spot toward the garden

steps.notes: Turns on the spot to face along the leg to the garden (no strafing).

control.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; leaves the score spot heading south, away from the hive
SET BY HAND: planning choice; lines up along the south wall heading west, well before the sweep

steps.notes: Nose-first to the east end of the RED garden line, ending heading west so the intake leads.

steps.name: intakeOn
steps.notes: Starts the intake before the sweep (no mid-path markers: Zenith's marker runner calls a Pedro method that Pedro 3.0.2 does not have).
Slow, intake leading, along the garden line.
Ends the sweep early if the robot reports full.
Collects the 4 RED garden pollen at 0.35 of top speed (at most 0.4 for a sweep).
Up to 0.6 s more for the last pollen.

steps.name: intakeOff
steps.notes: Stops the intake.
Backs out of the corner holding a west heading (turning next to the wall would swing a corner into it) to where there is room to turn.

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; 1 in along the next leg's start: a turn on the spot toward the score spot

steps.notes: Turns on the spot to face along the leg back to the hive.

control.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; heads north-east, away from the walls
SET BY HAND: planning choice; comes up from the south on x = -13, nose to the south cell

steps.notes: Nose-first back to the spot south of the hive, arriving facing the south cell.

steps.name: score
steps.notes: Volley 2: 4 garden pollen; the south cell reaches 8 and the hive TIPS (tip 1). The north cell comes up empty.

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; 1 in along the next leg's start: a turn on the spot toward flower0

steps.notes: Turns on the spot to face along the leg to flower0.

control.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; passes south of the hive frame's west foot bar (it ends at y = -19.5)
SET BY HAND: planning choice; lines up on flower0's centre line, heading west

steps.notes: Nose-first to flower0, the flower near the garden, ending heading west.

steps.name: intakeOn
steps.notes: Starts the intake before the slow approach.
Slowly nose-in to flower0's retrieval opening; the intake pulls its 4 pollen from the bottom.
Waits for the 4th pollen (the column drops one at a time).

steps.name: intakeOff
steps.notes: Stops the intake.
Backs straight off flower0, still facing it.

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; 1 in north: a turn on the spot to face north

steps.notes: Turns on the spot to face north.

control.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; straight north, west of the hive frame's west foot bar and legs
SET BY HAND: planning choice; 10 in back along the north-cell bearing, so the robot arrives facing the north cell

steps.notes: Nose-first round the WEST side of the hive frame (not under it) to the spot north of the hive, where the up cell is after tip 1; arrives facing the north cell.

steps.name: score
steps.notes: Volley 3: 4 flower pollen into the north cell (4 of 8).

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; 1 in north: a turn on the spot to face flower1

steps.notes: Turns on the spot to face flower1, straight north.

steps.name: intakeOn
steps.notes: Starts the intake before the slow approach.
Slowly nose-in to flower1's retrieval opening.
Waits for the 4th pollen.

steps.name: intakeOff
steps.notes: Stops the intake.

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; 1 in north of the score spot, where the turn back starts

steps.notes: Backs straight off flower1, still facing it.
Turns on the spot (over the last inch) to face the north cell.

steps.name: score
steps.notes: Volley 4: the north cell reaches 8 and the hive TIPS again (tip 2).

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; 1 in along the leg to the park spot: a turn on the spot

steps.notes: Turns on the spot to face along the leg to the park spot.
Nose-first to the park spot, partly in RED's loading zone.
